characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is the youngest and often underestimated son, with an average build and youthful appearance. He has curly brown hair and bright, curious eyes, suggesting his cleverness and resourcefulness. Askeladden wears simple, worn clothes fitting a humble background, including a long tunic and frayed trousers. He often carries a large wooden kneading trough, reflecting his practicality and determination to achieve his goals.

characters.name: Troll
characters.description: The Troll is a large, menacing figure residing across the lake from the royal palace. It possesses an intimidating presence with a stocky build, wild shaggy hair, and an ancient-looking visage. The Troll's clothing is primitive, made of rough fabrics, and adorned with trinkets from the forest. It is protective of its silver ducks and treasures, living in a mystical dwelling that blends into the mountain landscape.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: Trolddatteren, the Troll's daughter, is a curious character participating in her father's plans. She has long, dark hair often unkempt, with an earthy and ethereal appearance that blends with her mountainous surroundings. Her clothing is simple, reflecting her life in the wild, yet retaining a mystical elegance. She is tasked with handling Askeladden and keeping her father's treasures secure.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen is the regal and authoritative ruler of the land, with a stately posture and commanding presence. He has a strong, defined jawline, wearing luxurious garments with rich colors and fine embroidery, indicative of his status. His crown is modest yet elegantly crafted, signifying his fair and wise rule. He is often seen in the grand rooms of the palace, orchestrating the kingdom’s prosperity.

characters.name: Kongsdatteren
characters.description: Kongsdatteren, the princess of the realm, exudes grace and beauty. She has long, flowing hair and kind, expressive eyes, radiating warmth and charm. Her attire is regal, including long dresses of fine silk adorned with delicate patterns and gemstones, reflecting her royal lineage. She plays a pivotal role as Askeladden's reward, embodying the kingdom's prosperity and happiness.

characters.name: Staldmesteren
characters.description: Staldmesteren is a responsible and vigilant overseer at the royal palace, with a sturdy, robust physicality. He has short-cropped hair and sharp, observant eyes. Dressed in practical yet neat clothing suitable for his station, he sports a waistcoat and tailored breeches. Known for spreading important information, he often moves quickly throughout the palace grounds to fulfill his duties.

characters.name: Havemesteren
characters.description: Havemesteren is an industrious figure responsible for the palace gardens, with a lean build and weathered complexion from years of outdoor work. He exhibits a quiet introspection, with deep-set green eyes. His attire is practical, consisting of simple shirts, trousers, and sturdy boots, all marked by a faint aroma of earth and flora. Havemesteren is often seen tending to the plants and flowers, reflecting his dedication and skill.
